Pass ""seg"" instead of ""len"" when writing guest memory in kvm_clear_guest()
as ""seg"" holds the number of bytes to write for the current page
len"" holds the total bytes remaining.

column2: all users of kvm_clear_guest() are guaranteed to not cross a page
and so the bug is unhittable in the current code base.
